error_log.description: Path to the global error log file

log_level.description: Log level: alert, error, warning, notice, debug

start_servers.description: Number of child processes started at startup (used with 'dynamic' manager)

min_spare_servers.description: Minimum number of idle processes (used with 'dynamic' manager)

max_spare_servers.description: Maximum number of idle processes (used with 'dynamic' manager)

max_requests.description: Number of requests each child handles before being restarted (prevents memory leaks)

listen.description: Address on which to accept FastCGI requests (e.g., IP:port or path to Unix socket)

listen_allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IP addresses connecting to this pool (empty or 'none' = no restriction)

listen_backlog.description: Maximum length of the queue of pending connections; -1 means system default

listen_owner.description: Unix user for the socket file (when using Unix socket)

listen_group.description: Unix group for the socket file (when using Unix socket)

listen_mode.description: Unix permissions for the socket file (octal string)

user.description: User under which PHP processes run

group.description: Group under which PHP processes run

php_admin_value.description: PHP ini directives set via 'php_admin_value' (cannot be overridden in .htaccess or user scripts)

error_log.description: Path to error log for this pool

php_admin_flag.description: PHP ini boolean flags set via 'php_admin_flag' (cannot be overridden)

php_values.description: PHP ini settings that may be overridden in user scripts (via 'php_value' directive)

php_flags.description: PHP ini boolean flags that may be overridden (via 'php_flag' directive)

status_path.description: Relative URI for the pool status endpoint (requires 'pm.status_path' to be enabled)

slowlog.description: Path to the slow request log file

request_slowlog_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which a request is logged to the slowlog
